## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-feedback-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Navigate to private apps

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your HubSpot account. -->
2. Select **Settings** gear icon in the top navigation bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, navigate to Integrations → Private Apps. -->

## Step 3: Create a new private app

1. Select **Create a private app**.
2. <!-- manual: On the Basic Info tab, enter a name for your app (e.g., Ballerina Feedback Connector) and an optional description. -->

## Step 4: Configure required scopes

1. Select **Scopes**.
2. <!-- manual: In the search box, type feedback to filter relevant scopes. -->
3. <!-- manual: Under CRM, locate and enable the following scope: -->
4. <!-- manual: crm.objects.feedback_submissions.read: required to read feedback submissions. -->
5. <!-- manual: If your integration also needs to create or modify submissions, enable: -->
6. <!-- manual: crm.objects.feedback_submissions.write -->

## Step 5: Create the app and copy the access token

1. Select **Create app** in the top-right corner.
2. Review the scope summary in the confirmation dialog and click **Continue creating**.
3. On the app detail page, select **Show token** to reveal your private app access token.
4. <!-- manual: Copy the token; this is the value you will use as the privateApp credential in your connector configuration. -->

## Step 6: Set up OAuth 2.0 (optional: for third-party integrations)

1. <!-- manual: Go to the [HubSpot Developer Portal](https://developers.hubspot.com/) and create a developer account. -->
2. <!-- manual: Under Apps, click Create app. -->
3. <!-- manual: On the Auth tab, note the Client ID and Client Secret. -->
4. <!-- manual: Add the required scopes under Scopes: crm.objects.feedback_submissions.read. -->
5. <!-- manual: Set a Redirect URL for your application (e.g., https://your-app.example.com/oauth/callback). -->
6. <!-- manual: Direct users through the HubSpot OAuth authorization flow: -->
7. <!-- manual: Exchange the returned authorization code for an access token and refresh token via: -->
8. <!-- manual: Copy the refresh_token from the response for use in your connector configuration. -->
